title: GET /v1/commerce/acme/expected?after=<cursor>&limit=<n>, commerce key, read only: every key the broker has recorded for any label, in the order it was recorded, so that a CT watcher can tell an expected certificate from a mis-issued one. state reserved = recorded before the order and not yet confirmed (a certificate for it may exist), issued = confirmed, expired = never confirmed within the reservation lifetime (a certificate for it may still exist), released = replaced by a newer reservation before use. retired = the label is a tombstone. next is the cursor of the following page, null at the end.
